A small update focused on stability and tidier controls.

- Fixed Contours preview overload when dragging sliders quickly. Closes #156.
- Fixed panels jumping while resizing. Closes #157.
- Made the Colors wheel and triangle shrink with the panel. Follow-up to #152.
- Made resize grips fainter, with two stripes and color/opacity controls in Preferences > Interface.
- Moved tab scroll arrows to opposite ends of the strip. They only appear when needed, with no background and an accent color on hover. Follow-up to #149.
- Reduced log spam and added local timestamps, panic backtraces and filter errors.

Validation: 420 tests passed, 0 failed, 5 existing tests ignored. Clippy and formatting passed.

Further testing is continuing.
